title: EventEnvelope
description: The standard wrapper for every Kafka message on the platform. Matches the Java record com.neueda.orderservice.events.EventEnvelope. The five fields are the same on every event; payload holds the event-specific data.

eventId.description: Unique ID for this event (a UUID). Consumers use it to skip duplicate deliveries.

eventType.description: What happened. Must be one of the values in EventTypes.java.

occurredAt.description: When the event happened, as an ISO-8601 UTC timestamp.

key.description: The Kafka message key: the accountId for the orders and trade-events topics, the symbol for market-data.

payload.description: The event-specific data, e.g. the order details or the price update.
